findings_summary: NECTAR selective filtering: HIGH/CRITICAL-only for standard spawns cuts NECTAR section 60-75% (2500→625 tokens in experimental formula).
Pollen dedup: group-by-(agent,category) + 1-line summaries cuts pollen section 70-80% (1200→240-360 tokens).
Jinja2 template conditionals: skip background history + analysis appendix for task_complexity=simple cuts boilerplate 40-50% (100 tok of ~250 tok boilerplate).
Combined savings target: conservative formula 4K→1.5-2K tokens (50-60%); experimental formula 9.7K→3.5-4.8K tokens (50-65%).
FFMx impact: bundle-size drop raises FFMx because agent_tokens/main_tokens ratio improves (more work per bundle token).
Zero capability loss constraint: agents retain full HONEY (uncompressed), all HIGH/CRITICAL NECTAR, deduplicated pollen summaries with expand-on-demand path.
design_artifact_summary: Full design spec delivered in agent response text covering: (1) NECTAR filter threshold logic with --nectar-filter flag spec, (2) pollen_compressor.py 100-150 LOC design with group-by-category logic, (3) Jinja2 template conditional blocks keyed on task_complexity param. Validation framework: bundle_size_before/after in manifest, FFMx delta calculation, W1 agent capability smoke test protocol.
